sections.title: charaNam 1
lyrics: tamanoDane hori beTTavanu bennali potturamaNi bhUmiyanu tandhAyAsavU
amara vairiya karuLa kitta kaDu dhAvatiyokSameyanaLedI pAdha kamala nondhavo

sections.title: charaNam 2
lyrics: poDavi pAlakara vamshavanu vapana mADi koDaliyanu bisuTu malagidha bhAvavo
maDadhiyanu kaddoydhavana shiravanE tariduoDalinAyAsadhali pavaDisidha pariyo

sections.title: charaNam 3
lyrics: vAli modhalAdha edurAntha vIrara kondhu kALiya heDeya thuLithuLidhu
maiyalasitolIlegosuga bandhu nirvANadhali ninduA lajjegAgi thale bAgi malagidheyo

sections.title: charaNam 4
lyrics: nAlku yugadhAdhAri kaDege turagavaneri sAkAgi dhaNidhu nI nilli malagidheyo
sAkAriyAgi gauthama munIshvaranige bekeMdu nI koTTa varake malagidheyo

sections.title: charaNam 5
lyrics: innEshtu kAla nee nilli malagiddharoo - ninna yEbbisuvarObbaranu kANE
unnatha kAginElE - chEnna shrI rangapattaNadhA rangadhAma
